text: But I suppose I shall make my own atmosphere. That’s the true way--then you can breathe. Your surroundings seem very attractive.” “Ah, we too are a lovely group!” said Ralph. “Wait a little and you’ll see.” Miss Stackpole showed every disposition to wait and evidently was prepared to make a considerable stay at Gardencourt. She occupied herself in the mornings with literary labour; but in spite of this Isabel spent many hours with her friend, who, once her daily task performed, deprecated, in fact defied, isolation.
